To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the incidence of colorectal cancer increased in the Netherlands between 1989‐2014, that the use of postoperative adjuvant chemotherapy and preoperative (chemoradiation) therapy for colon and rectal cancers increased over the same period, that 5‐year survival for colorectal cancer patients increased, and that the increasing incidence of colorectal cancers favors the implementation of a screening program.
the incidence of both colon cancer and rectal cancer increased in the past 25 years.
